llm.summary: This skill is a coherent read-only GatherUp connector that uses the OOMOL CLI and does not show hidden, destructive, or deceptive behavior.

dimensions.detail: The allowed tool scope is limited to Bash commands beginning with oo, and credentials are described as handled server-side through the OOMOL connector.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: It includes a curl-to-shell oo CLI install fallback, but instructs agents to use it only when the CLI is missing, not proactively.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger wording is broad for GatherUp-related tasks, but the runtime instructions are limited to inspecting connector schemas and running read-only GatherUp actions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: First-time OOMOL login and GatherUp connection setup can create persistent account state, but this is disclosed and only used after auth or connection failures.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to search and read GatherUp data, and the artifact lists only get/list actions for businesses and customers.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this if you want Codex to retrieve GatherUp businesses and customers through your OOMOL-connected account. Be aware that read-only customer and business data may still be sensitive, and only complete the oo CLI login or GatherUp connection steps when you intend to use this integration.
llm.findings: [SQP-1] expected: The broad GatherUp trigger is real and worth narrowing, but the artifact-backed capability is read-only and purpose-aligned, so it does not justify a Review verdict by itself.
